## UnknownCollateralIndexError class

Thrown when a Midnight market collateral index is not configured.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class UnknownCollateralIndexError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.market`<!-- -->: Market id whose collateral list was queried.

- `params.collateralIndex`<!-- -->: Missing collateral index.

## Example


```ts
import { UnknownCollateralIndexError } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

throw new UnknownCollateralIndexError({
  market: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
  collateralIndex: 2n,
});
```
